purpose: Teach: 強姦/使徒/於い/草子/罎/謂/廣/來

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、性犯罪、つまり強姦罪の歴史的法制度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the historical legal framework of sexual crimes—specifically rape law, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, professionally curious. Leans forward slightly. Not interrogating—genuine interest in the student's work. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、十二使徒の文書研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote my paper on textual analysis of the Twelve Apostles documents.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Brief pause before answering, showing she's engaged. Respectful formality without stiffness. A touch of pride in her work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下に於いて活動した学者の動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also wrote on the activities and trajectories of scholars working during wartime, if I recall correctly.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. Thoughtful pause before the observation. She's testing Sakura's attentiveness, not accusingly—with warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、枕草子、つまり古典草子の文体研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I explored the linguistic style of the Pillow Book, the classical essay form that is.
lines.style: Steady response, matching Asuka's rhythm. Small pause to acknowledge the previous point. Direct but not defensive. Precise in her language.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 古い玻璃の罎、つまり瓶の考古研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your research on ancient glass bottles—the archaeological study of old glassware—that was also a focus of yours.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musingly. Slower pace than before. She's drawing out a pattern, not rushing to judgment. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、所謂、つまり謂わゆる古文の用法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote on the grammatical usage of the particle 'iwayuru'—the classical expression form, that is.
lines.style: Patient and precise. She's building her answers carefully. Small breath between clauses. Trusting that Asuka will understand where she's going.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 廣島、つまり旧字廣の地名表記の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Hiroshima, written in the older character form—the historical place-name notation—you researched that as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the observation. Slower, more deliberate. She's gently pressing forward. Not accusatory, but genuinely trying to understand something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、古典の來、つまり来の用法の文法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched the classical usage of 'kuru,' the verb form—its grammatical function and linguistic evolution.
lines.style: Final answer, marked by slight finality. She's being precise and clear. A breath of resolve at the end, like she's waiting for what comes next.
